en.title: Potential emergence in LLM agents: a statistical physics perspective
en.abstract: Post-training organises LLM agents' choices along a global potential. With agent states as intermediate variables, a partition function on the state space predicts this process, tested in two agent tasks.
en.alt: Post-training organises agent state transitions along a global potential

zh.title: LLM 智能体中的势能涌现：统计物理视角
zh.abstract: 后训练让 LLM 智能体的选择服从一个全局势能。把智能体状态作为中间变量，状态空间上的一个配分函数预言了这一过程，并在两个智能体任务中得到检验。
zh.alt: 后训练将智能体状态转移组织成全局势能的示意图
